text:
chen: CI turned red on the macOS matrix after the poetry lock merge in #3421. failing tests look like SSL handshake errors in our http client tests. anyone else seeing this?

infra-bot: build/redwood-inference/ci/pytest-matrix (macos-latest, py3.11) — FAILED — see logs: https://ci.example.com/build/9876 

chen: sample error from log: 
```
requests.exceptions.SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='packagerepo', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /v1/packages (Caused by SSLError(1, '[SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1123)'))
```

maria: hmm, we just merged poetry lock regen in #3421 (deps bumped: urllib3 2.1.0, certifi pinned -> 2024.3.1). macos runners have been flaky with openssl versions. @chen can you paste `pip freeze` from the failing job?

chen: paste from the job environment: 
```
requests==2.31.0
urllib3==2.1.0
certifi==2024.3.1
charset-normalizer==3.1.0
```
Also the job uses the macos-latest image (openssl 3.0 from system).

ade: curious — our linux jobs are green for the same revision?

chen: yes linux jobs are green, only macos matrix lanes fail.

sam: could be wheel binary differences on macOS (openssl linkage). Two quick options: 1) temporary pin urllib3 back to 2.0.x in CI to see if that fixes, or 2) bisect the lock regen to find the exact transitive that introduced the failure.

maria: can someone run a quick local macos-latest repro on an m1/amd mac runner? I can try on intel but bandwidth is limited.

ade: I can spawn a mac runner and reproduce in a container; give me 20. Also, do we have a minimal repro script?

chen: minimal repro I used in the job: 
```
python -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate
pip install -U pip
pip install requests==2.31.0 urllib3==2.1.0 certifi==2024.3.1
python -c "import requests; print(requests.get('https://packagerepo').status_code)"
```

ade: repro on macos-latest (intel) — same SSL verify error.

sam: thanks. can you run with `urllib3==2.0.4` to confirm?

ade: ran pip install requests==2.31.0 urllib3==2.0.4 certifi==2024.3.1 -> request succeeds (200).

maria: that suggests urllib3 2.1 changed something that interacts poorly with system openssl on macos. Not confident we should release that in our lock yet. Two immediate asks: 
- chen: open a PR to pin urllib3 to 2.0.4 in the CI lock (quick revert) so matrix can be unblocked
- someone: run a bisect or a minimal test to file an upstream reproducible issue for urllib3/requests if needed

chen: created PR #3440 with a temporary pin in the CI constraint file (poetry.lock not changed, CI-only override). requesting review @maria @sam

sam: LGTM for unblock. @ade can you double-check there are no side effects in other tests?

ade: double-checked unit and integration locally — all pass with the pin. I'll kick a macos rerun in CI once PR is merged.

ci-bot: PR #3440 merged by chen — CI rerun queued for build/9882

chen: rerun shows green on macos lanes now. thanks all.

maria: follow-up: please file a small repro issue and mention macOS system openssl/Apple TLS. I'll loop in infra-reliability to see if we should adjust our macos runner images or add explicit openssl build (vendored) for reproducibility.

chen: filing issue now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/129 — includes repro steps and diffs between urllib3 2.1 and 2.0.4. cc @ade @sam

sam: nice. For long-term: we should add a short test in our matrix that installs the exact system-provided OpenSSL-signed wheel and runs a simple TLS handshake to catch this earlier. created internal issue to track: INF-542

maria: summary: temporary CI pin applied, macos lanes green, need upstream bug/infra follow-up. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

chen: resolved for now. will keep monitoring and update INF-542 and infra issue.
